minecraft

minecraft converts a layout cell into a stream of Minecraft screen commands.

make test && ls -1 NCHDL.mc

cicpy minecraft ../transpile/SAR9B_CV.cic.gz ../transpile/demo.tech  NCHDL --x 0 --y 0
NCHDL.mc
